Psychology glossary

System 1 and System 2

A metaphor popularised by Daniel Kahneman to describe two modes of thinking: one fast, automatic and intuitive (System 1) and another slow, deliberate and effortful (System 2). They are not two parts of the brain but a useful way to understand when to trust intuition.

Related terms

  • Heuristic
  • Cognitive bias
